verdict.rationale: Bitwarden ships an integrated authenticator and a standalone Authenticator app, so reading codes from a smartwatch is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions a smartwatch or wearable app or complication. The documented TOTP surfaces cover the mobile apps, browser extension, desktop and CLI, which does not meet the story's requirement of reading codes without the phone.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
